nodes.name: 2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines — Volume 4 AFOLU

relationships.evidence: Climate Farm Demo publishes farm MRV/tool resources and DECiDE is one regional LCA-based farm tool relevant to this landscape.
relationships.constraints: No common calculation boundary or exchange format is confirmed.
relationships.validation_question: Compare a common farm case with declared boundaries and factor versions.

relationships.evidence: DECiDE models agricultural GHG emissions while IPCC Volume 4 supplies authoritative AFOLU estimation guidance.
relationships.constraints: No public implementation crosswalk was confirmed.
relationships.validation_question: Document equations, tiers and parameters actually used by DECiDE.
